texto:
The U.S. Constitution mentions political parties exactly zero times. No federal law requires a two-party system. George Washington even warned against the spirit of party in his farewell to the nation.

And yet, for more than 170 years, every single president has come from the same two parties.

In 1992, Ross Perot won almost 19% of the national vote. Nearly 20 million people. Electoral votes: zero.

In 2025, a record 45% of Americans called themselves independents, and 62% said a third major party is needed. In October 2026, just 14% approved of the job Congress is doing.

And heading into the 2026 midterms, only about 43 of the 435 House seats were rated competitive.

So why is it so hard to change? We opened the file. The full video is on the channel: FILE zero zero two.
titulo: The two-party system isn't in the Constitution #shorts
descricao: Zero mentions of parties in the Constitution — yet 170+ years of the same two. Every number has a source in the full video.
